verses.text: Those who trust hold fast, remembering that light is given to those who walk in truth, and a gentle answer turns away the storm.
The gathered assembly walk humbly, and the generous find joy that does not fade, and hope is renewed with each new morning.
The people rejoice, trusting that hope is renewed with each new morning.
The children of promise hold fast, remembering that kindness returns to the one who gives it freely.
The righteous find rest, and hope is renewed with each new morning.
All who listen lift up their voices, because understanding grows where the heart stays open.
Those who trust take courage, trusting that the humble are lifted in their season, and faith is made strong through steady obedience.
All who listen give thanks, for peace settles upon the patient heart.
The righteous hold fast, because mercy is shown to those who seek wisdom, and the generous find joy that does not fade.
The children of promise remember, trusting that hope is renewed with each new morning.
Every willing heart take courage, for the generous find joy that does not fade, and understanding grows where the heart stays open.
Every willing heart hold fast, trusting that peace settles upon the patient heart, and understanding grows where the heart stays open.
The people lift up their voices, for kindness returns to the one who gives it freely.
The humble remember, remembering that peace settles upon the patient heart, and a gentle answer turns away the storm.
The gathered assembly give thanks, and understanding grows where the heart stays open.
All who listen hold fast, for the generous find joy that does not fade, and light is given to those who walk in truth.
The children of promise take courage, trusting that the humble are lifted in their season.
The righteous lift up their voices, for faith is made strong through steady obedience.
The people rejoice, because peace settles upon the patient heart, and grace meets the one who waits with courage.
The people give thanks, and peace settles upon the patient heart, and mercy is shown to those who seek wisdom.
The faithful remember, trusting that the weary are strengthened by quiet trust.
